title: Choice of a good centre for the dual skeleton (step E1; Simon 6.5.1, (1)–(7))
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ with m + 1 < P. There is C ∈ ℝ≥0, depending only on P and m, such that for any two finite Borel measures μ, μ' on ℝ^P (Euclid P) there is a ∈ ℝ^P with |a_i − 1/2| < 1/4 for all i such that, writing L*(a) := {y : there is a finite set s of coordinate indices with |s| ≥ m + 2 and y_i − a_i ∈ ℤ for i ∈ s} and d := dist(·, L*(a)) (Metric.infDist), for every r with 0 < r ≤ 1/4: μ({x : d(x) < r}) ≤ C·r^{m+2}·μ(ℝ^P) and μ'({x : d(x) < r}) ≤ C·r^{m+2}·μ'(ℝ^P) (inequalities in [0, ∞], r^{m+2} read via ENNReal.ofReal).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ), m + 1 < P → ∃ C : NNReal, ∀ μ μ' : Measure (Euclid P), IsFiniteMeasure μ → IsFiniteMeasure μ' → ∃ a : Euclid P, (∀ i, |a i - 1 / 2| < 1 / 4) ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ 1 / 4 → μ {x | infDist x {w : Euclid P | ∃ s : Finset (Fin P), m + 2 ≤ s.card ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, ∃ z : ℤ, w i - a i = z} < r} ≤ C * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ (m + 2)) * μ univ ∧ μ' {x | infDist x {w : Euclid P | ∃ s : Finset (Fin P), m + 2 ≤ s.card ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, ∃ z : ℤ, w i - a i = z} < r} ≤ C * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ (m + 2)) * μ' univ
